notes.title: The Crown of Wu 30% discount for Spring Sales!
The Crown of Wu soundtrack!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317018/c73842a2bb65a1d22c00753f5aa4acf29546c052.png
The "Making Of" of the Crown of Wu soundtrack is now available!

If you're one of those people who can't understand a good game without a good soundtrack, you have another reason not to pass up The Crown of Wu. And now, good fortune is on your side: you can now watch this piece of making of in which Álex Elósegui and Sergio Villa, members of Wild Cat Records, explain in detail how the soundtrack of The Crown of Wu was composed and produced

[previewyoutube=-VVl2t5LeNQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The Crown of Wu's score seeks to highlight the darkness that follows the main character of the game, Wu. In this way we have a mix of oriental tradition and urban sound that evolves with the character's arc and his tenebrous intimate psychology. 

The experience of Wild Cat Records in the film industry was a source of good ideas that they presented to the development studio. They achieved a score with a narrative value that flows with the story. The traditional Chinese instruments, chosen by the producers, blend perfectly with the more technological elements of the world proposed by The Crown of Wu, where oriental legends merge with science fiction. And, above all, masterfully reinforce the mood of the game, so that you, gamer, can immerse yourself in this universe in an absolute way. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317018/a3827282790a1ec22049a88aa725980e6ffb1ca7.jpg

But why do we keep telling you about it when you can watch it in the documentary? More than twenty minutes of pure delight, where musicians and developers shake hands. Especially recommended for those who are interested in the videogame as a sum of arts. 

Believe us. When you see this making off you will understand why you feel like a tank aiming at a bell tower when you play The Crown of Wu. It's the power of music, comrade. 

Remember, The Crown of Wu is now available on PS4, PS5 and for PC via Steam.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1732220/The_Crown_of_Wu/

notes.title: The Crown of Wu Major Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317018/c73842a2bb65a1d22c00753f5aa4acf29546c052.png
The Crown of Wu Major Update

Attention fans of the monkey king! The adventure inspired by the Chinese legend of Wukong has a new update with all these new features:

Major Bug Fix

 Fixed an issue where you couldn't complete level 5 in a second run.
 Fixed an issue that made it impossible to activate the Pagoda if you die after opening the first chest and before opening the big gates.
 Solved the problem where the trophies were not activated in Steam. Now the lost trophies will be updated automatically when starting the game.
 Fixed an issue that prevented Wukong's animations from loading when healing during a teleport.
 Fixed an issue where Wukong's animations were stuck after QTE when you enter them with an attack animation.
 Fixed an issue where Wukong could get stuck in the moving pedestals
 Fixed an issue where some enemies were not suffering from the lightning power effect

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317018/d40c5262ddc9839e8f51bfaf82af6ad5ed8dbd97.gif

Minor Bug Fix

 The music in the last video is no longer coupled with the credits.
 Zhu's fire tornado no longer affects Wukong once Zhu is defeated.
 Level 6 mages no longer teleport out of the combat area
 Added mana recharge crystals in zones where they were required
 Fixed multiple incorrect collisions
 Fixed areas where it was possible to exit the map
 Fixed the triggers of several help messages

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317018/54ca06f6abc4e6bb340d68b8acd3f4956428365e.gif

The game puts us in the role of Wu in an adventure and a world inspired by Journey to the West, the traditional Chinese tale starring the Monkey King, where we will have to go from anti-hero to hero trying to regain the crown and take down Zhu.

Remember that The Crown of Wu is already available on PS4, PS5 and Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1732220/The_Crown_of_Wu/

notes.title: The Crown of Wu is available NOW!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317018/66d268a7f767b8ace94515d933f002d339b716b1.gif

¡The Crown of Wu is available NOW!

Finally, the boarding gates open to that game we've been telling you about for months. We are launching The Crown of Wu, the highly anticipated action-adventure title is now available on PS4, PS5 and for PC via Steam.

In addition, as we had announced, Meridiem Games has created the physical edition "Legend Edition" for PS5, with an exclusive design case, a set of postcards, and a letter addressed to the player. You can already find it in your favorite physical points of sale, because the best trips are worth keeping a souvenir. 

[previewyoutube=H4avQOztsA8;full][/previewyoutube]
 
Wu's crown must be found!
Explore a new world inspired by Journey to the West, a traditional Chinese tale about the Monkey King, Sun Wukong. Discover a future-past fantasy world as Sun Wukong, fighting alone against enemies and overcoming complex obstacles to recover the great Crown stolen by Zhu. With Zhu waiting to fight and kill you, will you be able to retrieve the Crown and save your world from destruction?

Featured content:

 A virtuoso update of Chinese mythology, transported to a science fiction world.
 A protagonist full of charisma who can master four different powers.
 Intuitive and fresh combat modes that promise hours of fun.
 Action, exploration, puzzles and parkour in a perfectly balanced ratio.
 A unforgettable soundtrack, composed by Wild Cat Records.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1732220/The_Crown_of_Wu/

notes.title: The Crown of Wu Releases March 24!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317018/c73842a2bb65a1d22c00753f5aa4acf29546c052.png

The Crown of Wu sets a date for your journey to the legendary East

If you're not excited about The Crown of Wu we have news that will for sure... The release date! 
We are in love with this amazing story set in legendary China, developed by Red Mountain in collaboration with the Trazos school, and that you will have the next March 24 in physical and digital stores by the hand of Meridiem Games and PlayStation Talents.

[previewyoutube=yPSuld1qHW4;full][/previewyoutube]

It's not only that The Crown of Wu will be released in digital edition for PC, PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5. In addition, Meridiem Games has created a special physical edition, "Legend Edition", which will be distributed in stores with an exclusive design sleeve, a set of postcards, and a letter addressed to the player, in which Wu himself, asks for help to regain his crown.

In The Crown of The Wu the player must recover Wu's lost crown to save the world that condemned him to prison for centuries. But first he will have to control his powers: fire, air, earth and lightning. In this story you will confront multiple enemies, through a simple and intuitive combat system. You will also have to explore its spectacular sceneries and use all your cleverness and skill to go through them.

Go practice eating with chopsticks because we're going to China, buddy!

notes.title: The Crown of Wu - Demo Update
notes.content:
Monkey King fans, attention! The adventure inspired by the Chinese legend of Wukong has a new demo and will introduce all these new features: 

Combat and movement

 Added blocking ability
 Improved feedback on hits and blocks during combat.
 Fixes in the buffer of the attacks that improve the feeling when doing the pierce attack
 Fixed a bug that caused the focus to change during combat
 Fixed a bug that caused the sprint to be reactivated when it shouldn't be
 Fixed a bug where the camera shake during the sprint remained perpetual
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317018/6aff2788abcf280ce7b9110ac5566b1a89044403.gif


Level Design

 Redesigned tutorials
 Improved the windmill puzzle design
 Fixed several bugs related with collisions
 Fixed a bug where the videos of the monoliths didn't play correctly
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317018/8e1bbc54a3b06a1199b865644e53843bd4f3b3e6.gif


UI

 Improved HUD and pause menu artwork
 Added control information on creepers
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317018/cd60f6bab86490f28def087bfb6464240cc1d9fb.gif


Options

 Added fullscreen and window options
 Added V-Sync option
 Improved multi-language translations

FX & SFX

 Added missing audio effects
 Added visual aids on interaction actors
 Improved healing skill FX
 Fixed camera blur and depth of field
 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42317018/a53e08ef1a57afd1ab24a80ef5686b0bed8bc4de.gif


The game puts us in the role of Wu in an adventure and a world inspired by Journey to the West, the traditional Chinese tale starring the Monkey King, where we will have to go from anti-hero to hero trying to recover the crown and end Zhu.

If you liked the demo, don't forget to add The Crown of Wu to wishlists!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1732220/The_Crown_of_Wu/
